Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, red ball. Lily loved to play with her ball every day. She would throw it, kick it, and even bounce it high in the air.
One day, Lily saw a big, unknown dog in the park. The dog was very big and had a big smile. Lily wanted to play with the dog, but she was scared. She did not know what to do.
Lily asked her mom, "Can I play with the unknown dog?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful." Lily and her mom played
